drhp.business: SIPL develops, builds and operates roads and highways, with in-house Operations and Maintenance (O&M) capabilities across two primary business models: Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) and Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM). Its client portfolio consists chiefly of statutory bodies and government authorities, including NHAI, Ahmedabad Urban Development Authority (AUDA), and various state Public Works Departments (PWDs). The company generates revenues primarily from toll collection, user fee and annuity receipts, and also provides operation, maintenance, advisory and project management services for its …
drhp.expansion: SIPL is actively executing a strategic expansion to capture high-value infrastructure opportunities across new geographies, while maintaining a dominant footprint in Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Haryana, Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh, Telangana, and Gujarat. Rather than new capacity build-out, the company's stated near-term expansion posture centres on monetising existing HAM/BOT projects and pursuing fresh project wins, supported by a leaner cost structure following operational-cost reduction.

litigation.note: Directors' Report: no significant material orders have been passed by the Regulators or Courts or Tribunals which would impact the going concern status of the Company and its future operations.

- Delays due to disputes, rehabilitation concerns, and lengthy approval processes increase project costs and timelines; bureaucratic hurdles, litigation and coordination problems among multiple agencies often slow project execution.
- Earlier BOT-based concession models often relied on aggressive traffic projections and highly leveraged financing structures that became difficult to sustain; financial stress remains a continuing concern in several operational projects despite the shift to HAM/EPC structures.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Emphasis on efficient cash flow management, viewed as the discipline that determines resilience in an asset-heavy business.
- Monetising and realising value embedded in projects through substitution of Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM) projects, to unlock value, reduce obligations, and redirect resources to more productive avenues.
- Reducing operational costs to establish a leaner cost structure ahead of pursuing fresh projects.
